lemmas.primary_translation: preference for the underrepresented gender even when people of the other gender should otherwise rank ahead

definitions.text: det at det kjønnet som er underrepresentert, blir foretrukket selv om personer fra det andre kjønnet ut fra andre utvelgelseskriterier skulle gått foran
definitions.translation: the fact that the underrepresented gender is preferred even though people of the other gender should, on the basis of other selection criteria, have ranked ahead
